One night at home while helping our three young children settle and tucks the sleeping girl, we decided we’d start an indoor fire, something they rarely do and which the little boys found quite fun in its very dangerous aspects.
“Don” said little Ethan as they played at building our makeshift wood shed for our pretend cabin fire.
It would never have caught. It’s made with metal sheets.
I looked over as Ethan handed my brother one, not thinking.
It fell into an old box on fire from my burning of sage.
A fireball of sparks rose into air from where I thought nothing was flamed at.
We were both frozen
